critical_code_review_comments: MyVerify.jsx L93: inner span `${docType === t ? 'text-orange-500' : 'bg-slate-200 text-white'}` — when selected, span loses the slate-200 bg (good) but has no border; the check icon renders as naked orange glyph. Visually fine per screenshot, but tests reading the outer button className won't see 'text-orange-500' — selector tests should query the inner span.

MyVerify.jsx L83-85: the active-tab underline uses `-top-5 md:-top-7` positioning the orange bar ABOVE the tab text; design calls for 'orange top underline' which matches (small bar at top of tab card). Confirmed visually.
AccountLayout.jsx L56: using `max-lg:w-1/6` with 7 total children (6 nav + logout) means logout overflows horizontally — correct; overflow-x-auto scroll reveals it. Confirmed in prior iteration.
